faqs.a: Most clips run 6–15 seconds — the length that performs best across product pages and paid social placements. Longer formats are available on request.

faqs.q: Can you use my existing photos as the source?
faqs.a: Yes — catalog or lifestyle images, from us or your own library, can be used as the visual base for video.
Vertical (9:16), square (1:1), and horizontal (16:9) exports are available to match every placement.
